description: This Java class 'ArtifactInfoGatherer' traverses and extracts artifact-related information from screen widget models and actions within the OFBiz framework, collecting entity names, service names, screen locations, and request locations.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses widget and action models to gather artifact information such as entity names, service names, screen locations, and request locations.

methods.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gatherer with an artifact info context.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Overloaded methods implementing the visitor pattern for various widget and action model types, extracting relevant artifact info.

methods.name: visitModelForm
methods.description: Processes a ModelForm to extract entity names, service names, target locations, and related request locations, including nested fields.
